fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: The visa on arrival costs 500,000 Indonesian rupiah, can be paid by cash or card, and is valid for a single entry only.
entry.es: La visa a la llegada cuesta 500.000 rupias indonesias, se puede pagar en efectivo o con tarjeta y es válida para una sola entrada.
entry.quote: The VOA costs 500,000 Indonesian rupiah and can be paid by cash or card. It is valid for single entry only.

entry.en: Before travelling you must fill out the online customs and health declaration on the All Indonesia arrival card website or app within 72 hours of arrival.
entry.es: Antes de viajar debes completar la declaración aduanera y de salud en línea en el sitio web o la app All Indonesia arrival card dentro de las 72 horas previas a la llegada.
entry.quote: Before travelling to Indonesia, fill out the online customs and health declaration on the All Indonesia arrival card website or app within 72 hours of arrival.

entry.en: To get a visa on arrival you must have proof of your onward or return journey.
entry.es: Para obtener la visa a la llegada debes tener comprobante de tu viaje de continuación o de regreso.
entry.quote: and you must have proof of your onward or return journey.

entry.en: You need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Necesitas un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país incluido como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Indonesia, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: The visa must be extended within the initial 30 days to avoid an overstay fine of 1 million rupiah a day.
entry.es: La visa debe prorrogarse dentro de los primeros 30 días para evitar una multa por exceso de estadía de 1 millón de rupias al día.
entry.quote: Make sure you extend your visa within the initial 30 days to avoid an overstay fine of 1 million rupiah a day.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Indonesia.
safety.es: Es probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Indonesia.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Indonesia.

safety.en: Protests, demonstrations and political rallies should be avoided because they can become violent without warning.
safety.es: Se deben evitar las protestas, manifestaciones y mítines políticos porque pueden volverse violentos sin previo aviso.
safety.quote: Avoid all protests, demonstrations and student and political rallies as they can become violent without warning.

safety.en: Reported cases of rape and sexual assault are high in Bali and Lombok, so be alert at night and avoid poorly lit areas.
safety.es: Los casos denunciados de violación y agresión sexual son elevados en Bali y Lombok, así que conviene estar alerta de noche y evitar zonas mal iluminadas.
safety.quote: Reported cases of rape and sexual assault are high in Bali and Lombok. Be alert when out at night, and avoid areas that are poorly lit.

safety.en: There have been deaths and serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Indonesia.
safety.es: Ha habido muertes y casos de enfermedad grave causados por bebidas alcohólicas con metanol en Indonesia.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Indonesia.

safety.en: Those caught with illegal drugs may face long prison sentences or the death penalty.
safety.es: Quienes sean sorprendidos con drogas ilegales pueden enfrentar largas penas de prisión o la pena de muerte.
safety.quote: and those caught may face long prison sentences or the death penalty.

safety.en: Indonesia has many active volcanoes, which can erupt without warning and have caused damage and loss of life.
safety.es: Indonesia tiene muchos volcanes activos que pueden entrar en erupción sin previo aviso y han causado daños y muertes.
safety.quote: Indonesia has many active volcanoes. Volcanoes can erupt without warning and have caused damage and loss of life.

health.en: Tap water is not safe to drink in Indonesia.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es segura para beber en Indonesia.
health.quote: Tap water is not safe to drink in Indonesia.

health.en: Dengue fever can be contracted anywhere, so insect repellent (DEET) and mosquito nets are highly advisable.
health.es: El dengue puede contraerse en cualquier lugar, por lo que se aconseja mucho usar repelente (DEET) y mosquiteros.
health.quote: Dengue fever can be contracted anywhere, so using insect repellents (DEET) and mosquito nets is highly advisable.

health.en: Malaria prophylaxis is not necessary for Java or Bali but is wise for extended stays in remote parts of Sumatra, Borneo, Lombok or points east.
health.es: La profilaxis contra la malaria no es necesaria en Java ni Bali, pero es aconsejable en estancias largas en zonas remotas de Sumatra, Borneo, Lombok o más al este.
health.quote: Malaria prophylaxis is not necessary for Java or Bali, but is wise if travelling for extended periods in remote areas of Sumatra, Borneo, Lombok or points east.

health.en: There are many street dogs in Bali and elsewhere and monkeys around temples, and rabies exists in both wild and domestic animals.
health.es: Hay muchos perros callejeros en Bali y otros lugares, y monos cerca de templos, y la rabia existe tanto en animales salvajes como domésticos.
health.quote: There are many street dogs in Bali and elsewhere, and monkeys around temples and tourist areas. Rabies exists in both wild and domestic animals, including pets.

health.en: The standard of local medical care can be poor and some medical tests cannot be performed reliably.
health.es: La calidad de la atención médica local puede ser deficiente y algunas pruebas médicas no se pueden realizar de forma fiable.
health.quote: The standard of local medical care can be poor and some medical tests cannot be performed reliably.

health.en: Medical evacuation can cost tens of thousands of pounds, so adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds are needed.
health.es: La evacuación médica puede costar decenas de miles de libras, por lo que se necesita un seguro médico de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles.
health.quote: Medical evacuation can cost tens of thousands of pounds. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Indonesia are ambulance 118, fire 112 and police 110.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Indonesia son ambulancia 118, bomberos 112 y policía 110.

help.en: FCDO in London can be called on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours, for urgent help if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres al 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas, para ayuda urgente si algo le ha pasado a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote:
You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

Telephone: 020 7008 5000 (24 hours)

getting_in.en: Most visitors arrive at Ngurah Rai (DPS) in Bali or Soekarno-Hatta (CGK) in Jakarta.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de los visitantes llega a Ngurah Rai (DPS) en Bali o a Soekarno-Hatta (CGK) en Yakarta.
getting_in.quote: Most visitors to Indonesia arrive at Ngurah Rai (DPS IATA) in Bali or Soekarno-Hatta (CGK IATA) in Jakarta.

getting_in.en: Airports in secondary cities such as Bandung, Yogyakarta, Surabaya and Medan also have international flights from Singapore and/or Malaysia.
getting_in.es: Aeropuertos de ciudades secundarias como Bandung, Yogyakarta, Surabaya y Medan también tienen vuelos internacionales desde Singapur y/o Malasia.
getting_in.quote: Many airports in secondary cities such as Bandung, Yogyakarta, Surabaya, and Medan also have international flights from Singapore and/or Malaysia

getting_in.en: Citizens of all ASEAN countries going for leisure, transit or business can stay up to 30 days without a visa.
getting_in.es: Los ciudadanos de todos los países de la ASEAN que viajen por ocio, tránsito o negocios pueden permanecer hasta 30 días sin visa.
getting_in.quote: Citizens of all ASEAN countries who are going for leisure, transit, or business are allowed to stay in Indonesia for up to 30 days without a visa.

getting_around.en: Because of the vast area and lack of fixed links between islands, the only rapid long-distance travel within Indonesia is by air.
getting_around.es: Por la gran extensión y la falta de enlaces fijos entre islas, la única forma rápida de viajar largas distancias dentro de Indonesia es en avión.
getting_around.quote: Indonesia's vast area and lack of fixed links between islands mean that the only rapid means of long-distance travel within Indonesia is by air.

getting_around.en: The state-owned PELNI runs giant ferries to practically every major inhabited island, on journeys that can take a week end to end.
getting_around.es: La estatal PELNI opera grandes ferris a prácticamente todas las islas habitadas importantes, en viajes que pueden durar una semana de punta a punta.
getting_around.quote: The largest company is the state-owned PELNI, whose giant ferries visit practically every major inhabited island in Indonesia on lengthy journeys that can take a week from end to end.

getting_around.en: Java has by far the best railway network, linking Jakarta with Surabaya, Semarang, Yogyakarta and Solo.
getting_around.es: Java tiene con diferencia la mejor red ferroviaria, que conecta Yakarta con Surabaya, Semarang, Yogyakarta y Solo.
getting_around.quote: Java has by far the best railway network, with trains connecting the capital city, Jakarta, with other main cities such as Surabaya, Semarang, Yogyakarta and Solo.

getting_around.en: The Whoosh high-speed line opened in 2023 and connects Jakarta and Bandung in as little as 30 minutes.
getting_around.es: La línea de alta velocidad Whoosh abrió en 2023 y conecta Yakarta y Bandung en tan solo 30 minutos.
getting_around.quote: a Chinese-built line from Jakarta to Bandung somewhat cringily named Whoosh, opened in 2023 and, running at up to 350 km/h, connects the two cities in as little as 30 minutes.

getting_around.en: Ride-hailing for cars and motorbikes via smartphone apps is available in more than 200 Indonesian cities.
getting_around.es: Hay transporte por aplicación para autos y motos en más de 200 ciudades indonesias.
getting_around.quote: Ride-hailing for both cars and motorbikes, powered by smartphone apps, is available in more than 200 Indonesian cities.

getting_around.en: Bluebird taxis are significantly more expensive than Gojek and Grab but offer far more professional service.
getting_around.es: Los taxis Bluebird son bastante más caros que Gojek y Grab, pero ofrecen un servicio mucho más profesional.
getting_around.quote: Bluebird is significantly more expensive than both but offers far more professional service.

money.en: Indonesia's currency is the rupiah (Rp, ISO code IDR).
money.es: La moneda de Indonesia es la rupia (Rp, código ISO IDR).
money.quote: Indonesia's currency is the rupiah, abbreviated Rp (ISO code: IDR).

money.en: Visa, MasterCard and JCB cards are widely accepted in hotels and larger restaurants and stores, but American Express can be problematic.
money.es: Las tarjetas Visa, MasterCard y JCB se aceptan ampliamente en hoteles y restaurantes y tiendas grandes, pero American Express puede ser problemática.
money.quote: Visa, MasterCard and JCB debit/credit cards are widely accepted in hotels and larger restaurants and stores, but American Express can be problematic.

money.en: ATMs on the international Plus/Cirrus or Alto networks are common in all major cities and tourist destinations.
money.es: Los cajeros de las redes internacionales Plus/Cirrus o Alto son comunes en todas las ciudades principales y destinos turísticos.
money.quote: ATMs (pronounced ah-teh-em in Indonesia) on the international Plus/Cirrus or Alto networks are common in all major Indonesian cities and tourist destinations.

money.en: Banks and money exchange are widely available on Java, Bali and Lombok but can be a major headache elsewhere, so carry rupiah to outer islands.
money.es: Hay bancos y casas de cambio en Java, Bali y Lombok, pero pueden ser un gran problema en otros lugares, así que lleva rupias a las islas exteriores.
money.quote: Banks and money exchange are widely available on Java, Bali and Lombok, but can be a major headache anywhere else, so load up with Rupiah before heading off to any outer islands.

money.en: Tipping is not a universal practice in Indonesia.
money.es: La propina no es una práctica universal en Indonesia.
money.quote: Tipping is not a universal practice in Indonesia.

money.en: Fancy restaurants and hotels charge 10% government sales tax plus a variable service charge.
money.es: Los restaurantes y hoteles elegantes cobran 10% de impuesto a las ventas más un cargo de servicio variable.
money.quote: Fancy restaurants, hotels and the like will charge 10% government sales tax plus a variable service charge.

etiquette.en: Indonesia is by and large a conservative country and modest dress is advisable.
etiquette.es: Indonesia es en general un país conservador y se aconseja vestir con modestia.
etiquette.quote: By and large, Indonesia is a conservative country and modest dress is advisable.

etiquette.en: Using your left hand is considered very rude because it is used to wash oneself after using the toilet.
etiquette.es: Usar la mano izquierda se considera muy grosero porque se usa para lavarse tras ir al baño.
etiquette.quote: Never use your left hand! It is considered very rude as one uses one's left hand to wash one's privates after using the toilet.

etiquette.en: Remove your footwear outside before entering a house unless the owner explicitly allows you to keep it on.
etiquette.es: Quítate el calzado afuera antes de entrar a una casa, a menos que el dueño te permita expresamente dejártelo puesto.
etiquette.quote: Remove your footwear outside before entering a house, unless the owner explicitly allows you to keep it on.

etiquette.en: Saving face is extremely important in Indonesian culture, so in a dispute you should not try to win or accuse the person at fault.
etiquette.es: Salvar las apariencias es muy importante en la cultura indonesia, así que en una disputa no debes intentar ganar ni acusar al culpable.
etiquette.quote: Saving face is extremely important in Indonesian culture. If you should get into a dispute with anybody, don't try to 'win' or argue and accuse the person at fault.

etiquette.en: Avoid touching the top of anyone's head, as some cultures there consider it a holy part of the body.
etiquette.es: Evita tocar la cabeza de alguien, pues algunas culturas allí la consideran una parte sagrada del cuerpo.
etiquette.quote: Avoid touching the top of anyone's head as some cultures here consider it as a holy part of their body.

etiquette.en: Do not try to shake hands with a Muslim woman unless she offers her hand first.
etiquette.es: No intentes dar la mano a una mujer musulmana a menos que ella ofrezca la suya primero.
etiquette.quote: However, don't try to shake hands with a Muslims woman unless she offers her hand first.

connectivity.en: You can roam, buy an eSIM before arrival, or buy an Indonesian SIM card after arrival, which typically gives the best coverage and prices.
connectivity.es: Puedes usar roaming, comprar una eSIM antes de llegar o comprar una SIM indonesia al llegar, que suele dar la mejor cobertura y precios.
connectivity.quote: To use your mobile phone in Indonesia, you can either roam using your home provider, purchase an eSIM from a travel eSIM provider before you arrive, or (typically for the best coverage and prices) purchase an Indonesian SIM card after you arrive in Indonesia.

connectivity.en: Tourist plans sold at the airport are usually the best option for a short visit.
connectivity.es: Los planes para turistas que se venden en el aeropuerto suelen ser la mejor opción para una visita corta.
connectivity.quote: The tourist plans you can buy at the airport are usually the best option for a short visit to Indonesia

connectivity.en: Using an Indonesian SIM for more than 90 days requires registering your phone's IMEI with Customs, otherwise you lose connectivity after 90 days.
connectivity.es: Usar una SIM indonesia más de 90 días exige registrar el IMEI del teléfono en la Aduana; de lo contrario se pierde la conectividad tras 90 días.
connectivity.quote: If you plan to use your phone in Indonesia (using any Indonesian SIM card as opposed to international roaming) for more than 90 days, then you must register your phone's IMEI with Indonesian Customs, otherwise you will lose connectivity after 90 days.

connectivity.en: In large cities there are free Wi-Fi hotspots in some restaurants and stores and in many parks and public utility areas.
connectivity.es: En las grandes ciudades hay puntos de Wi-Fi gratis en algunos restaurantes y tiendas y en muchos parques y áreas de servicio público.
connectivity.quote: In large cities, there are free Wi-Fi hotspots in some restaurants, stores, and in many parks and public utility areas.

connectivity.en: Indonesia practices internet censorship, with some 70,000 sites blocked, including DuckDuckGo and many LGBTQ+ dating apps.
connectivity.es: Indonesia practica censura de internet, con unos 70.000 sitios bloqueados, incluidos DuckDuckGo y muchas apps de citas LGBTQ+.
connectivity.quote: Indonesia practices internet censorship and some 70,000 sites are blocked. The vast majority of these are porn, but some common sites such as DuckDuckGo and many LGBTQ+ targeted dating apps are also blocked
